kept.reason: No assertion maps: this test checks packaging/release.sh's dry output (both arch archives hold only sesame, formula version/urls/sha256s/test block, gh and git never run); the 76 shared lines are only the binary's startup for --version, which the guide test runs for help text. Nothing in the setups to share, so no merge.

No assertion maps onto one_password_vault_store: this test checks the local copy (no op call while a token is valid, cross-machine sync without a second refresh, rebuild under a rotated service account token or a damaged copy, logout and archive reaching another machine); vault_store checks the vault wiring (item fields, no secret in files or argv). Setups conflict: this one's 30 s login token makes the first call refresh, while vault_store's refreshed-1 / --min-life assertions need an hour-long one, and its identity URL changes the op call/write counts asserted here.

kept_files.reason: main.rs is the command-line seam: ~half its prod lines are the clap definitions and help text (the CLI's interface itself), the rest a dispatch where each arm is one call into a deep module (providers, oauth, source/refresh, standing, store, api::Call). Its 90-day churn is new flags/commands landing here and logic moving out (api.rs, standing.rs, source.rs, refresh.rs, wire.rs); the deletion test only moves the clap surface, it concentrates nothing. Left inline: a few lines of user messages and the stdin-or-prompt secret read used twice, too small to be a module.
